name: pam_havebeenpwned
detailed_description: PAM module that leverages the IHaveBeenPwned API to prevent users from choosing passwords that have appeared in data breaches. Runs during password change to validate password strength.
notes:
Similar to pam_pwnd but alternative implementation. Choose one for password breach checking.
